verdict.rationale: Remote documents its own employee onboarding flows: employments are created via `POST /v1/employments` with type-specific onboarding, country-specific required fields defined by dynamic JSON schemas, and embeddable drop-in onboarding flows. None of the evidence shows the specific forms or the new-hire self-serve step. missing for 10: evidence of a new-hire-facing self-serve invite flow, W-4 collection, I-9 collection, bank/payment detail capture, pre-start-date completion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
